entries.detail: akin-android has no README.md file at the project root. The rule requires every project to have a README stating what it is and how to run it. Create a README.md that describes the project purpose and provides build/run instructions (e.g., Gradle build steps, environment setup for the Android app, how to run tests).

entries.detail: All five target projects lack the graphify hybrid auto-update system: none have graphify-out/ directory, none have .git/hooks/post-commit installed, and none have a LaunchAgent loaded. Rule PS-004 requires every project to be graphified with auto-update enabled. The .gitignore should include graphify-out/ (after line 12) and the post-commit hook must be installed by running graphify-hybrid <project-path> on each project.
entries.rule_title: Every project has a graphify knowledge graph with auto-update installed

entries.detail: Checked git history with `git log --diff-filter=A --follow -- <file>` in /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin-server-side. The repo's first commits (05e28b6d, c179d1a4, both 2021-06-01) added README.md and then a full Vapor app (Sources/App/Controllers, Models, Migrations, routes.swift, etc.) with no architecture/behavior/slice-list docs present. The four spec-artifact roles now exist as akin-server-side/ARCHITECTURE.md (how it's structured, line 1: "# Architecture, marketing funnel attribution"), acceptance-tests.md (what correct behavior is), coding-practices.md, and COVERAGE_CHECKLIST.md (slice list) — but all were first committed on 2026-08-08 (ARCHITECTURE.md, acceptance-tests.md, coding-practices.md, commit 95f38c9c) or 2026-08-01 (COVERAGE_CHECKLIST.md, commit c0e3a91b), roughly five years after the first code commit. Fix: for retroactive spec artifacts on a mature codebase, either backdate/annotate them as post-hoc documentation rather than pre-implementation specs, or (per the rule as written) treat any future implementation slices in this repo as requiring the four artifacts to land before the corresponding code commit, not after. I checked akin-server-side only in depth; I also spot-checked interstice, whose first two commits (db6b7f6, 2026-07-30) added README.md, docs/GOAL_LOOP.md (slice list), and docs/design-brief.html (structure/behavior) before any lib/ code landed in the following commit — that one passes. I did not run the same git-history check on akin, AkinFrontBackModels, or akin-android; scope was limited to a handful of targeted checks per the economical-search constraint, so coverage of those three is incomplete and should not be read as a pass for them.
entries.rule_title: The four spec artifacts exist before implementation begins

entries.detail: Read /Users/scottlydon/Developer/interstice/scripts/loop9_toolcheck.sh in full (40 lines) and ran ripgrep for '/Users/scottlydon/[A-Za-z]+|localhost:[0-9]+' across interstice/scripts, bin, hooks, hotkeys and across akin-android/scripts and run-parity-loop.sh. Offense: line 13 `AND="/Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin-android"` hardcodes the akin-android project's absolute path inside a tool (this file explicitly checks tools "this loop invokes", i.e. it interacts with another project) and then uses $AND on line 35 to locate that project's gradlew wrapper. Fix: derive it at runtime, e.g. `AND="${AKIN_ANDROID_ROOT:-$(cd "$(dirname "${BASH_SOURCE[0]}")/../.." && pwd)/akin-android}"` or require an env var, following the exact pattern already used correctly elsewhere in this session's targets at /Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin-android/run-parity-loop.sh:94 (`CONTRACTS="${AKIN_CONTRACTS_ROOT:-/Users/scottlydon/Developer/iOS/AkinFrontBackModels}"`) and line 102 (`IOS="${AKIN_IOS_ROOT:-/Users/scottlydon/Developer/akin}"`), both of which already accept a runtime override and are not offenses under this rule. No other hardcoded cross-project paths or localhost:PORT values were found in the scripts/bin/hooks/hotkeys directories searched.
entries.rule_title: Anything touching another project is target agnostic
